excerpt: The tank was built in 1915 by Purity Distilling Company.
The tank had reportedly leaked previously.
Structural engineers later found its walls too thin and its material vulnerable to cracking.
A combination of poor construction, temperature changes and a large shipment contributed to the rupture.
The wave moved at approximately 35 mph.
A 1925 court-appointed auditor attributed the disaster to negligence by the tank owners.
